_about: Single source for every statutory statement used in this kit. Docs and code refer to entries by key. Paraphrases only; no statutory text is quoted. Correct an entry here and it is corrected everywhere it is displayed. Not legal advice; not reviewed by an attorney.
source: Chaptered text of SB 574 (Stats. 2026, ch. 858), read 2026-11-25.

sb574_enactment.paraphrase: Approved Sept. 30, 2026. No urgency clause. Operative Jan. 1, 2027. Adds Bus. & Prof. Code § 6068.1, amends Code Civ. Proc. § 128.7, adds Code Civ. Proc. §§ 180 and 1282.1, and amends Bus. & Prof. Code § 6173.

bpc_6068_1_a3Bi.paraphrase: An attorney using generative AI must take reasonable steps to verify its output, including all case and statutory citations.

bpc_6068_1_a3Bii.paraphrase: The attorney must also correct hallucinated output.

bpc_6068_1_a3C.paraphrase: Disclose generative AI use to the court for documents submitted to the court.
bpc_6068_1_a3C.open_question: Exact scope of this duty is not settled in this kit. See OPEN_QUESTIONS.md, question 3.

bpc_6068_1_b2.paraphrase: A list of personal identifying information categories relevant to what may be entered into AI tools. Item (I) covers sealed or confidential content.
bpc_6068_1_b2.note: The individual list items are not reproduced here. Their text was not available when this file was written.

ccp_128_7_b2A.paraphrase: A brief, pleading, motion or other paper filed in any court must not contain any citation that the responsible attorney has not personally verified. This covers any citation, not only cases and statutes.

ccp_128_7_d1.paraphrase: Monetary sanctions may not be imposed on a represented party for a violation of subdivision (b)(2).

ccp_128_7_g.paraphrase: The section still does not apply to discovery papers.

no_citator_product.paraphrase: The statute does not require any particular citator product.
